recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, centered photograph of a motorcyclist riding toward the viewer on a rural road, set against a dramatic, sepia-toned sky with heavy storm clouds. The scene is topped with bold, chrome-styled custom lettering that features speed lines and a strong upward diagonal tilt.
coreVisualRelationships: The motorcycle's vertical chrome forks align with the central axis of the composition.
The diagonal tilt of the typography mirrors the perspective of the road receding into the distance.
The warm, golden-brown sky contrasts with the cool, metallic sheen of the chrome text and bike parts.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the rider
Chrome-textured display typography with speed-line accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The motorcycle and rider are centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing large and imposing due to the low camera height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, circular headlight of the motorcycle serves as the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large display text at the top, follows the diagonal slant down to the rider, and then follows the road lines toward the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by a vast, textured sky which provides a backdrop for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones in the sky and landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the rider's clothing and the road.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool silver and reflective chrome in the bike and the main title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between the bright sky and the dark silhouette of the rider.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and metallics

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, italicized sans-serif with extended horizontal strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Letters feature a thick outer stroke/border
Horizontal speed lines extend from the left side of the glyphs
Sharp, angular terminals that suggest motion
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial capital letters are significantly larger and overlap the following lowercase-style glyphs
The 'S' features an elongated tail that underlines part of the word

treatment.outline: thick black and thin white double-stroke

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex, illustrative chrome logo paired with a clean, high-visibility block sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and slant for the subtitle.
The display text requires custom vector work to achieve the speed-line and chrome effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photograph of a man on a classic cruiser motorcycle riding toward the camera. The setting is a flat rural landscape with a fence on the left and a red-dirt road on the right. The sky is filled with dramatic, dark, sepia-toned storm clouds with a golden glow near the horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, chrome-textured custom logo at the top, tilted upwards at 15 degrees. Add speed lines extending from the left of the letters. Below it, place a bold, all-caps sans-serif subtitle in white with a black drop shadow, following the same 15-degree tilt.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle low enough to make the bike look heroic?
Does the typography have a metallic chrome finish?
Is the color palette restricted to sepia, gold, black, and silver?
Are the speed lines present on the main title?

adjustableVariables: Amount of chrome reflection in the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title wording
Exact facial features of the rider
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the rider's head.
Check that the chrome reflections look consistent with the sky lighting.
Verify the perspective of the road leads toward the center.
Confirm the speed lines do not create visual clutter.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle motorcycle photography + sepia storm sky + 15-degree tilted chrome speed-typography.
